definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony or official event, such as a graduation ceremony, award ceremony, or other commemorative occasion.

examples.japanese: {式典|しきてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{式典|しきてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A dress is required for the ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{式典|しきてん}。

notes:
A formal, official ceremony or commemorative event. More formal and larger in scale than {式|しき} alone.

TYPES:
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{式典|しきてん}: graduation ceremony
- {授賞|じゅしょう}{式典|しきてん}: award ceremony
- ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧{式典|しきてん}: opening ceremony
- ⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧{式典|しきてん}: closing ceremony
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧{式典|しきてん}: commemorative ceremony

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {式典|しきてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a ceremony
- {式典|しきてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a ceremony
- {式典|しきてん}⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: ceremony venue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {式|しき}: ceremony (shorter, broader — includes weddings, funerals)
- ⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧: ritual, rite (often religious or traditional)
